symptom: Container can ping itself but can't reach the internet, internal services, or even the gateway

diagnostic_steps.action: Test layers in order: localhost, gateway, external
diagnostic_steps.command: docker exec <c> sh -c 'ping -c1 127.0.0.1 && ip route show default | head -1 && ping -c1 $(ip route show default | awk "{print \$3}") && ping -c1 8.8.8.8 && getent hosts example.com'

diagnostic_steps.action: Check DOCKER chains exist + masquerade present
diagnostic_steps.command: sudo iptables -t nat -L DOCKER -n; sudo iptables -t nat -L POSTROUTING -n | grep MASQ

diagnostic_steps.expected: default ACCEPT or rules permitting your traffic

fix_steps.command: sudo sysctl -w net.ipv4.ip_forward=1; echo 'net.ipv4.ip_forward=1' | sudo tee /etc/sysctl.d/99-docker-fwd.conf

fix_steps.action: Restart docker to repopulate iptables chains
For host firewall (firewalld/ufw) interfering, add docker0 to trusted zone

symptom: After enabling firewalld/ufw, all container egress dies; docker iptables rules exist but don't apply

fix_steps.command: # /etc/ufw/before.rules: -A POSTROUTING -s 172.17.0.0/16 -o eth0 -j MASQUERADE\n# /etc/default/ufw: DEFAULT_FORWARD_POLICY="ACCEPT"\nsudo ufw reload

symptom: Container can reach gateway but not external internet; tcpdump on host shows packet leaving with container's source IP

diagnostic_steps.command: sudo iptables -t nat -L POSTROUTING -n -v | grep MASQ

fix_steps.action: Recreate via docker daemon restart (it owns these rules)

symptom: `getent hosts service-name` works inside container but resolves to old IP; service moved to a new container

diagnostic_steps.expected: compare to docker network inspect <net> output

fix_steps.action: Disconnect+reconnect to refresh DNS records on the bridge
fix_steps.command: docker network disconnect <net> <c>; docker network connect <net> <c>

fix_steps.action: Use stable name (compose service name) over container name

symptom: VPN client on host (Tailscale, OpenVPN) breaks docker bridge networking; containers can't reach internet

diagnostic_steps.command: ip route show; docker network ls -q | xargs docker network inspect | jq '.[].IPAM.Config[0].Subnet'
diagnostic_steps.expected: VPN route or subnet collides with docker default 172.17/16

symptom: Compose `secrets:` and `configs:` mounted but apps reading from wrong path or missing

diagnostic_steps.expected: secrets at /run/secrets/<name>; configs at / by default

fix_steps.command: # secrets: - source: cred, target: /etc/myapp/cred (instead of default /run/secrets/cred)

fix_steps.action: Don't put runtime config in secrets (use configs:)
fix_steps.command: # secrets are read-only and 0400 by default; configs are 0444 and editable per mode

symptom: Multi-stage Dockerfile: ARG declared at top but value undefined inside a later FROM stage

diagnostic_steps.command: # ARG before any FROM is global; ARG inside a stage is scoped to that stage only

fix_steps.action: Declare ARG inside each stage that consumes it
fix_steps.command: # FROM base AS s1\nARG VERSION\nRUN echo $VERSION

fix_steps.action: Or inherit ARG and assign to ENV
fix_steps.command: # at top: ARG VERSION  \n# in stage: ARG VERSION\nENV VERSION=$VERSION

symptom: `docker compose watch` configured but file changes don't trigger sync/rebuild

diagnostic_steps.action: Verify file actually under a watched path
diagnostic_steps.command: # the watch path must include the changed file
